text: fasterize exactextract produce dense output: full raster matrix every cell value (NA). O(area) memory. controlledburn produces sparse output: non-empty cells recorded. Interior cells run-length encoded ($runs), boundary cells individual records ($edges). O(perimeter) memory. storage section playproj: rasterize makes comparison bytes tiles touched, dense mask, row runs, bounding box fractions, runs plus edge fractions. Resolution scaling: polygon 8×7, 16×14, 32×28 resolution. Interior cells (blue) grow area (O(n²)); boundary cells (coral) grow perimeter (O(n)). Sparse output stores blue runs coral edges — white cells cost nothing. resolution increases, number interior cells grows O(n2)O(n^2) (area) number boundary cells grows O(n)O(n) (perimeter). sparse representation stores occupied cells — high resolution, ’s overwhelmingly interior runs, compress handful (row, col_start, col_end) records per row. controlledburn can burn 25,954 Antarctic rock outcrop polygons onto 8-trillion-cell grid 8 seconds using 438 MB memory. dense raster require ~30 TB.

code: blk <- clum$getBlockSize(1)[2] strip_r <- (r$runs$row - 1L) %/% blk strip_e <- (r$edges$row - 1L) %/% blk strips <- sort(unique(c(strip_r, strip_e))) runs <- split(r$runs, factor(strip_r, strips)) edges <- split(r$edges, factor(strip_e, strips))  expand_runs <- function(x) {   n <- x$col_end - x$col_start + 1L   i <- rep(seq_len(nrow(x)), n)   data.frame(row = x$row[i], col = x$col_start[i] + sequence(n) - 1L,              w = 1, id = x$id[i]) }  system.time({   tally <- lapply(names(runs), function(s) {     e <- edges[[s]]     cells <- rbind(expand_runs(runs[[s]]),                    data.frame(row = e$row, col = e$col, w = e$fraction, id = e$id))     r0 <- min(cells$row); nr <- max(cells$row) - r0 + 1L     c0 <- min(cells$col); nc <- max(cells$col) - c0 + 1L     v <- clum$read(1L, c0 - 1L, r0 - 1L, nc, nr, nc, nr)     code <- v[(cells$row - r0) * nc + (cells$col - c0) + 1L]     code[is.na(code)] <- 0L     rowsum(cells$w, cells$id * 1000 + code, reorder = FALSE)   })   tally <- do.call(rbind, tally)   tally <- rowsum(tally, as.numeric(rownames(tally))) }) ## about 90 s over the network, 40 s from a local copy key <- as.numeric(rownames(tally)) tab <- data.frame(id = key %/% 1000, code = key %% 1000, area_m2 = tally[, 1] * 2500)
